tasks.task_summary: Cross-reference Figma designs to ensure complete business goal coverage in bug bash spreadsheet
tasks.evidence: User provided two Figma URLs. Agent used Figma MCP tools (get_screenshot, get_metadata) to explore the design file. Used subagents to enumerate all pages and screen frames (7 pages total). Got screenshots of key screens (stage move start, pending, confirmed, pipeline mapping). The investigation was thorough but the Figma file was complex (50+ nodes on one page). The one redirect was user providing the Figma URLs which agent did not have.
tasks.counterfactual: Agent should have proactively asked for Figma URLs earlier when building the initial spreadsheet, knowing this was a UI feature.

summary: Bug bash spreadsheet creation session with iterative refinement. Initial spreadsheet was well-structured but coverage was incomplete -- agent generated test cases from CLAUDE.md objectives without cross-referencing Figma designs. User had to redirect twice (ask about business goal completeness, then explicitly request Figma cross-referencing). PM alignment update was handled correctly. The Figma exploration was thorough once triggered. Key lesson: for UI features, always cross-reference designs before declaring test plan complete.
